page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top: "LECTORI." with page number "194" at upper left. Text in one column at right, with a wide empty column at left. Below the text, a finis line and a faint ghost of show-through from the reverse page. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: rint: Quorum si quando iussu euocata fuerit, euolabit illa (quò lubet) in vulgus illico, Iesuitasque (superciliosum genus hominum, & nimio quàm turbulentum) vltro irritabit; Excidit mihi interea, homini credulo, exemplar vnum, quod quidem cuius in manus diuenerit, nec scio, nec suspicor; quicunque is demùm fuerit, moneo, si a lege sibi Plagiariâ cautum velit, vt Sigalionem mecum sedulò colat; sicque latere pergat, vt fallat vsque natus, morienque.

page.notes: The left column is blank. Faint show-through of the reverse page (Greek/Latin fragments) appears in the lower right and is not transcribed. "Iesuitasque" is printed as "lesuitasque" with a long-s-like I; read as Iesuitasque. The word "morienque" follows a hyphen "mo-" at the line end ("mo-rienque"), joined here as printed.
